description:
The Google keywords any domain ranks for (its own site or a competitor's), ordered by the traffic each sends: position, ranking URL, monthly search volume, CPC, keyword difficulty and search intent, plus the domain's totals — organic keyword count, estimated monthly organic traffic and its ad value, and how many keywords are new, up, down or lost. DataForSEO's Google index, refreshed monthly; estimates, not the site's own Search Console numbers (query_search_console has those for a connected site).

Billing: 10¢ per call. Not billed when nothing comes back or the call fails; the same call again within 24h is free. On the no-account server, a caller without credit gets one data call a day free.

Inputs:
  domain — e.g. "linear.app".
  country — ISO code (US, CA, GB, AU, NZ, IE, IN, SG, ZA, AE, DE, AT, CH, FR, ES, IT, NL, SE, FI, MX, BR); default from the domain's TLD, else US.
  limit — 10–60 keywords, default 50.

Returns { domain, country, totals: {organic_keywords, estimated_monthly_traffic, traffic_value_usd, top_3, positions_4_10, positions_11_20, new, up, down, lost}, keywords: [{keyword, position, previous_position, url, search_volume, cpc_usd, keyword_difficulty, intent, estimated_traffic}], cached, charged_cents }.

Example: { domain: "linear.app", limit: 25 }

country.description: Google market, ISO code (US, CA, GB, AU, NZ, IE, IN, SG, ZA, AE, DE, AT, CH, FR, ES, IT, NL, SE, FI, MX, BR). Default from the TLD.

name: get_domain_keywords
title: Keywords any domain ranks for in Google
